select V.ID, V.CARD_NO as cardNo, V.PERSON_NAME as personName, V.CREATE_USER, V.CREATE_TIME as createTime, P.PARK_NAME as parkName, V.REASON from SMT_BLACK_VISITOR V inner join SMT_PARK P on V.PARK_ID = P.ID
AND CARD_NO LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.cardNo}),'%')
AND PERSON_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.personName}),'%')
AND PARK_ID =#{query.parkId}
and V.PARK_ID in
#{item}
order by CREATE_TIME desc
